note: The seven community types used in the platform dataset.

items.label: Chat Group
items.description: Real-time or near-real-time conversation among members, typically organized into channels or rooms.

items.label: Citizen Science
items.description: Community-based collection, classification, or analysis of scientific data; participation structured by projects.

items.label: Discussion Forum
items.description: Asynchronous threaded discussion, often with voting or ranking of posts.

items.label: Listserv / Email
items.description: Email-based group communication; each list server independently hosted.

items.label: Social Network / Media
items.description: Profile-based social communication, often with public posts and follow relationships.

items.label: Peer Production
items.description: Collaborative creation of shared artifacts (e.g., wikis, documentation, encyclopedias).

items.label: Workplace
items.description: Communication platforms designed for coordination among coworkers or project teams.
